internal pipeline language in public body
full-article brand-coloured background or website masthead
treating a brand-kit canvas as a colour mandated by the logo
copying reference PART labels and large pale-teal heading cards
repeating the opening paragraph as a summary

editorialTypography.chapter: rounded near-black numeric tags and bold title; chapter count follows the article, no fixed four-part cap
editorialTypography.bodyEmphasis: selective strong phrases chosen from actual copy, 3px #82C38C bottom border; short phrases stay together; no fixed emphasis count
editorialTypography.briefGroups: Local near-black heading blocks, light group title and #82C38C label; count follows actual groups.
editorialTypography.caption: 14px functional neutral grey, distinct from group headings

covers.layout: Adapt to content using the same identity; the 500-client example is not a fixed cover template.
